description: This file defines the Education display field class within a reporting module of the OrangeHRM project. It extends a listable display field class and specifies methods to get DTO class info, entity aliases, and field names relevant to education data.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField\Education\Education
classes.description: A class representing the education display field for reports, extending ListableDisplayField. It provides specific implementations for retrieving DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the associated Education DTO.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array with the entity alias used, in this case 'education'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array with the specific database field 'employee.empNumber' used in this display field.
